data.name: Muttalib
data.long_meaning: Means 'he who seeks or travels'. Derived from the name of Prophet Ibrahim's father who was also known as Azar. He is said to have searched for the Kaa'ba for years.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes determination, perseverance, and a strong desire to find one's purpose in life.
data.numerology_meaning: Indicates a life filled with change, versatility, and resourcefulness.

in_arabic.name: مُطَلِب
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُطَلِب اسمٌ عربیٌ یُشير إلى الفرد الذی یُطالب بِالعَدلِ وَالصِدقِ، یُستخدم هذا الاسم فی الإسلام فی إشارة إلى الشخص الذی یُطالب بِالحق وَالعَدل، فی إطار إصلاح المجتمع وَالحفاظ علیه

in_urdu.name: مُطَلِب
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جس کا مقصد حق اور انصاف کی وہابی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُطَلِب ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو حق اور انصاف کی وہابی ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے آپ کو حق اور انصاف کے حامی کے طور پر دیکھتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: मुतलीब
in_hindi.meaning: वह व्यक्ति जो न्याय और सत्य की मांग करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुतलीब एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ वह व्यक्ति है जो न्याय और सत्य की मांग करता है, यह नाम मुसलमानों में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है जो कि न्याय और सत्य के पक्ष में होते हैं

in_pashto.name: مُطَلِب
in_pashto.meaning: څوک چې حق او عدل پوښوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُطَلِب یوه عربي نام دی چې د کوم څوک لپاره کارول کېږي چې حق او عدل پوښوي، دا نام په افغانستان او پښتونو کې هم کارول کېږي چې د حق او عدل لپاره کارول کېږي

in_english.name: Muttalib
in_english.meaning: The one who demands justice and truth
in_english.long_meaning: Muttalib is an Arabic name that refers to the person who demands justice and truth, it is used in Islam to refer to the person who demands justice and truth in the context of reforming society and protecting it, it is also used in other cultures and languages to refer to the person who demands justice and truth

data.cultural_impact: The name Muttalib carries a rich cultural heritage in Islamic tradition, reflecting the perseverance and dedication of Prophet Ibrahim's father, Azar, in his search for the Kaa'ba, the holiest site in Islam. This name represents a deep sense of determination and a willingness to travel great distances to seek out that which is dear and valuable.
data.spiritual_significance: Muttalib, as a name, serves as a reminder of the spiritual journey each individual embarks upon in life. Just as Prophet Ibrahim's father, Azar, sought out the Kaa'ba, we too are encouraged to strive towards our spiritual goals, remaining steadfast in our pursuit of truth and righteousness. This name embodies the spirit of the Islamic concept of 'Iradah' orintention, as it encourages us to set our hearts on pleasing Allah and to travel the spiritual path with unwavering commitment.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Abu al-Amin Ahmad ibn Khalid al-Harithi (d. 652 CE) is known as Muttalib in some sources. The name Muttalib carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Muttalib was an early Islamic figure, possibly a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
